rules.name: Favor of the Crowd Faction Objective
rules.description:
The crowd’s attention often flits from champion to champion throughout the battle,
with each pilot looking to impress viewers with a spectacular feat of combat.

The first Lorican Champion unit you activate each turn is your favored champion for
that turn. During its activation, your favored champion gets 1 free overcharge which
does not require that you expend a command point to use (though it still adds STs to
the unit as usual).

---------------------------------------------------

If your favored champion causes at least one injury on an enemy model, you gain +1
command point.

The first time one of your favored champions destroys an enemy unit, you also gain +3
VPs, but after that you no longer gain +1 command point when your favored champion
causes at least one injury.

rules.name: Epic Hero Faction Objective
rules.description:
A champion occasionally reaches legendary status, becoming an epic hero not only on
their own fleetship, but also so infamous that enemies come looking to best them.

When declaring this as your faction objective, choose one of your Lorican Champion
models to be your epic hero. Each turn during its activation, your epic hero gets up
to 3 free overcharges, which do not require that you expend command points to use
(though they still add STs to the unit as usual).

---------------------------------------------------

Each turn during its activation, if your epic hero destroys an enemy unit, you gain +1 VP.
If your epic hero is destroyed, your opponent gains +1 VP. A unit’s epic hero status no
longer applies if it returns to play as a reinforcement.

rules.name: The Great Hunt Faction Objective
rules.description:
During Artarian feastdays, the crowd votes in real-time which enemy they want
destroyed next. Champions jockey with each other to destroy this target first, as doing
so brings great honor to their house.

Each turn when activating your first unit, nominate one enemy unit to be the great
hunt target for the turn. A great hunt target immediately gains D3 STs, and increases
the result needed to pass discipline checks by 1 (so if the unit normally needed a 3+
to pass its discipline check it would now need a 4+).

---------------------------------------------------

Whenever your great hunt target is destroyed, you gain +1 VP and additional command
points based on which of your units managed to destroy the great hunt target:
• Your first activation of the turn: +2 command points.
• Your second activation of the turn: +1 command point.

Once you have gained +3 VPs from this objective, the hunt has ended and you may not
select any further great hunt targets.

sharedRules.name: Crowd Favorites
sharedRules.description:
• During each command phase, a Remnant player generates an additional +1 command point for every 3 Lorican Champions they have on the table.
• Lorican Champions may have command points allocated onto them during each command phase, as though they had the Command ability. Unless a Lorican Champion actually has the Command ability, it may not use its command points to issue orders.

sharedRules.name: Overcharge
sharedRules.description:
A champion may expend their command points to boost their performance:
• Boost Movement:
Add +2 to the champion's MV characteristic for one move. Costs 1 command point and adds 2 STs to the champion per use. This cannot improve the champion's MV by more than +4.
• Boost Weapon:
Add +1 to the SHO characteristic of the champion's weapon for one round of shooting. Costs 1 command point and adds STs to the champion equal to that weapon's DAM characteristic, per use. This cannot improve a weapon's SHO by more than double its unmodified value.
• Boost Dodge/Field:
Add +1 to a champion's existing Dodge, Dug-in or Field or ability value for one round of enemy shooting, after seeing the enemy's rolls to hit. Costs 1 command point and adds 2 STs to the champion per use.
• Vent Heat:
Remove STs from the champion right before it takes a Discipline Check. Costs 1 command point per ST removed.

sharedRules.name: Cloak Generator
sharedRules.description: This champion's EVS characteristic is improved by +2 and it gains the Dug-in (+1) ability.

sharedRules.name: Enhanced Targeter
sharedRules.description: This champion has +1 SKL. Maximum of 1 Enhanced Targeter per champion.

sharedRules.name: Hologram Projector
sharedRules.description: When this unit is declared as a charge target, immediately reduce that charge distance by D6+1”. If this reduction means the target cannot be reached, then the enemy may perform a different main action instead. Maximum of 1 Hologram Projector per champion.

sharedRules.name: Lorican Boostpack
sharedRules.description: This champion has the Mobile designator and the Dynamic Move ability. Its MV characteristic is improved by +2 and its EVS characteristic is improved by +1.

sharedRules.name: Mark of the Initiate
sharedRules.description: This champion has -2 SKL, -1 FOR and -1 WP. No more than one champion per detachment may have Mark of the Initiate.

sharedRules.name: Target Tracker
sharedRules.description: The Dodge ability may not ignore hits caused by this champion. Maximum of 1 Target Tracker per champion.

sharedRules.name: Thermal Tracker
sharedRules.description: This unit may draw line of sight entirely through area terrain features as though they were not there. Maximum of 1 Thermal Tracker per champion.

sharedRules.name: Prime Ability - Mobile Strike
sharedRules.description: Once per turn, when an active friendly unit within 24" that is on the move shoots, it ignores the usual wild fire penalty for being on the move for that round of shooting.

sharedRules.name: Reflex Shield
sharedRules.description: You may force enemy melee weapon hits to be re-rolled during CQ fighting that targets this unit.

sharedRules.name: Prime Ability - Counterattack
sharedRules.description: Once per turn when an active friendly unit within 24" shoots at the enemy unit that last activated, that friendly unit gets +2 SKL for the round of shooting.

sharedRules.name: Heart of the Remnant
sharedRules.description: This champion does not have the Kill Mission ability, despite being a behemoth.

sharedRules.name: Prime Ability - Focus Fire
sharedRules.description: Each turn, if this unit shoots during its main action and the next friendly activation after that shoots at the same primary target, that targeted enemy unit gains an additional +D3 STs.

sharedRules.name: Prime Ability - Strike & Vanish
sharedRules.description: Once per turn, when a friendly unit within 24" that is not in contact with the enemy performs either an Advance & Fire or Dash action, it may choose to shoot first and then move.

sharedRules.name: Active Scan
sharedRules.description: Immediately after this champion completes either an Advance & Fire or Hold & Fire main action, it may make an active scan. An active scan causes this champion, and all enemy units within 18" of it, to be treated as if hit in their front arc by a weapon with the Paint (2+) ability.

sharedRules.name: Fire Assist (+1)
sharedRules.description: A model with this ability is able to fire (+1) more weapons during each round of shooting than they are normally allowed. Note that when a model is not allowed to fire at all, this ability does not allow them to.

rules.name: Defensive Countermeasures
rules.description: This champion may re-roll misses when firing defensively, including defensive fire that is wild.

rules.name: Vent System
rules.description: When this champion shakes off STs, remove an additional D3 STs for each Vent System that is equipped. When venting heat via the Overcharge ability, for each command point spent, remove 1 extra ST for each Vent System that is equipped.

rules.name: Mark of the Initiate
rules.description: This champion has -2 SKL, -1 FOR and -1 WP (included in profile). No more than one champion per detachment may have Mark of the Initiate.

rules.name: Lorican Field Generator
rules.description: This champion has the Field (1) ability.

rules.name: Prime Array
rules.description: The model's Command ability value is improved by +1.

rules.name: Target Tracker
rules.description: The Dodge ability may not ignore hits caused by this champion.

rules.name: Enhanced Targeter
rules.description: This champion has +1 SKL. (Included in profile)

rules.description: This champion's EVS characteristic is improved by +2 and it gains the Dug-in (+1) ability.

rules.name: Lorican Boostpack

rules.name: Pinpoint Scanner
rules.description: This model has the Paint (2+) ability on all its non-CQ attacks.

rules.name: Pathfinder Array
rules.description: Friendly units arriving via Aerial Insertion within 6” of this unit do not gain STs if ending their arrival move touching an obstacle or area terrain.
